opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government. Must be ordinarily resident in Scotland and have completed at least two full years of secondary schooling or college education in Scotland, or have a substantial and recent connection to Scotland.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for individuals from low-income households who want to study for a first degree at university, or a second degree in limited subject areas.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented students from low-income Scottish households who are unable to afford the costs of postgraduate study.
opportunities.summary: Helps graduates in Scotland meet the costs of postgraduate study.
